easy: To move something quickly up and down or back and forth.

ex.en: Shake the bottle before you drink the juice.
ex.ko: 주스를 마시기 전에 병을 흔들어라.

easy: To move a little again and again, like when you are cold or scared.

ex.en: My hands shook when I walked onto the stage.
ex.ko: 무대에 올라갈 때 내 손이 떨렸다.

easy: Big or important enough to matter.

ex.en: Our team won by a substantial number of points.
ex.ko: 우리 팀은 상당한 점수 차로 이겼다.

easy: Between 13 and 19 years old.

ex.en: My teen cousin helps me with my homework.
ex.ko: 십대인 사촌 형이 내 숙제를 도와준다.

easy: A young person who is 13 to 19 years old.

ex.en: The teens played soccer after school.
ex.ko: 십대 아이들이 방과 후에 축구를 했다.

easy: A tool that catches an animal so it cannot get away.

ex.en: Dad set a trap to catch the mouse in the garage.
ex.ko: 아빠는 차고의 쥐를 잡으려고 덫을 놓았다.

easy: A trick that catches you when you do not expect it.

ex.en: The last question on the quiz was a trap.
ex.ko: 퀴즈의 마지막 문제는 함정이었다.

easy: Always the same, with no changes.

ex.en: The houses on our street are all a uniform white.
ex.ko: 우리 동네 집들은 모두 똑같은 흰색이다.

easy: Made of wood.

ex.en: I keep my toys in a wooden box.
ex.ko: 나는 장난감을 나무 상자에 넣어 둔다.

easy: Stiff and not natural, like someone who cannot move or speak smoothly.

ex.en: He sounded wooden when he read his lines in the play.
ex.ko: 그는 연극 대사를 읽을 때 어색하고 뻣뻣하게 들렸다.

easy: Very eager to push hard to get what you want.

ex.en: She is an aggressive player who runs after every ball.
ex.ko: 그 애는 모든 공을 쫓아가는 적극적인 선수다.

easy: Ready to attack or fight others.

ex.en: The aggressive dog barked at everyone.
ex.ko: 그 공격적인 개는 모든 사람에게 짖었다.

easy: Easy to see or understand.

ex.en: It was apparent that the baby was sleepy.
ex.ko: 아기가 졸리다는 것이 분명했다.

easy: Looking true, but maybe not really true.

ex.en: His apparent anger was really just a joke.
ex.ko: 그가 겉으로 보인 화는 사실 장난이었다.

easy: To hit something very hard.

ex.en: He banged his fist on the table.
ex.ko: 그는 주먹으로 탁자를 쾅 쳤다.

easy: To make a loud, sudden noise.

ex.en: The shutters banged in the wind all night.
ex.ko: 바람에 덧문이 밤새 쾅쾅 소리를 냈다.

easy: To shut something hard so it makes a loud noise.

ex.en: Do not bang the door when the baby is sleeping.
ex.ko: 아기가 자고 있을 때는 문을 쾅 닫지 마라.

easy: To make a very loud sound.

ex.en: The radio blasted music across the room.
ex.ko: 라디오가 방 안에 음악을 요란하게 울려 댔다.

easy: To hit something very hard.

ex.en: He blasted the ball over the fence.
ex.ko: 그는 공을 울타리 너머로 세게 쳐 날렸다.

easy: To break something apart with a bomb or other explosives.

ex.en: Workers blasted the rocks to make a road.
ex.ko: 인부들이 길을 내려고 바위를 폭파했다.

easy: Words you say when you are unhappy about something.

ex.en: Mom listened to my complaint about the cold soup.
ex.ko: 엄마는 식은 수프에 대한 내 불평을 들어 주셨다.

easy: One of the parts that something is made of.

ex.en: Eggs are an important component of this cake.
ex.ko: 달걀은 이 케이크의 중요한 구성 요소다.

easy: One of the parts that a machine is made of.

ex.en: The mechanic replaced a broken component in the car.
ex.ko: 정비사가 자동차의 고장 난 부품을 교체했다.

easy: Being brave when something is scary or hard.

ex.en: It took courage to jump off the high diving board.
ex.ko: 높은 다이빙대에서 뛰어내리려면 용기가 필요했다.

easy: To make a sick person well again.

ex.en: The doctor cured my sore throat.
ex.ko: 의사 선생님이 내 아픈 목을 낫게 해 주셨다.

easy: To treat food with salt or smoke so it lasts a long time.

ex.en: Grandpa cures ham with salt.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 소금으로 햄을 염장하신다.

easy: Feeling braver and more sure of yourself.

ex.en: I felt encouraged after my teacher said I did a good job.
ex.ko: 선생님이 잘했다고 하셔서 나는 힘이 났다.

easy: The day or night before a special day.

ex.en: We open one present on Christmas Eve.
ex.ko: 우리는 크리스마스 이브에 선물 하나를 연다.

easy: The short time right before something big happens.

ex.en: On the eve of the big game, the team stayed calm.
ex.ko: 큰 경기 직전에 팀은 침착했다.

easy: Words that tell you how well you did something.

ex.en: The teacher gave me helpful feedback on my story.
ex.ko: 선생님은 내 이야기에 도움이 되는 피드백을 주셨다.

easy: A person who fights, like in a battle or a boxing match.

ex.en: The brave fighter never gave up.
ex.ko: 그 용감한 전사는 절대 포기하지 않았다.

easy: A fast army airplane that battles other planes.

ex.en: A fighter jet flew over the air show.
ex.ko: 전투기 한 대가 에어쇼 위를 날았다.

easy: Turned into ice because it is very cold.

ex.en: We skated on the frozen lake.
ex.ko: 우리는 얼어붙은 호수에서 스케이트를 탔다.

easy: Not moving at all, like a statue.

ex.en: I stood frozen when I saw the big spider.
ex.ko: 나는 큰 거미를 보고 얼어붙은 듯 꼼짝 못 했다.

easy: Being in a place where no one can find you.

ex.en: The rabbit stayed in hiding until the fox left.
ex.ko: 토끼는 여우가 떠날 때까지 숨어 있었다.

easy: Being kind and caring toward people and animals.

ex.en: She showed great humanity when she helped the hurt puppy.
ex.ko: 그 애는 다친 강아지를 도우며 큰 인정을 보여 주었다.

easy: A new thing that someone made after lots of trying.

ex.en: The electric light was a great innovation.
ex.ko: 전구는 위대한 혁신이었다.

easy: A short coat that you wear over your clothes.

ex.en: Put on your jacket, it is cold outside.
ex.ko: 재킷을 입어, 밖이 추워.

easy: A cover that wraps around something, like a book.

ex.en: The book jacket has a picture of a dragon.
ex.ko: 책 겉표지에 용 그림이 있다.

easy: Having to do with the group that makes the laws.

ex.en: Congress is the legislative part of the U.S. government.
ex.ko: 의회는 미국 정부의 입법 기관이다.

easy: Done with your hands.

ex.en: Playing the piano takes manual skill.
ex.ko: 피아노를 치려면 손재주가 필요하다.

easy: Run by a person, not by a machine.

ex.en: This is a manual pencil sharpener that you turn by hand.
ex.ko: 이것은 손으로 돌리는 수동 연필깎이다.

easy: Needing hard work with your body.

ex.en: Digging holes is manual labor.
ex.ko: 구덩이를 파는 것은 육체노동이다.

easy: The work of taking care of people who are sick or hurt.

ex.en: My aunt works in nursing at a hospital.
ex.ko: 이모는 병원에서 간호 일을 하신다.

easy: The job of a nurse.

ex.en: My sister wants to study nursing.
ex.ko: 우리 언니는 간호학을 공부하고 싶어 한다.

easy: Being used by someone, or busy.

ex.en: The bathroom is occupied right now.
ex.ko: 화장실은 지금 사용 중이다.

easy: Having people living in it.

ex.en: Every apartment in our building is occupied.
ex.ko: 우리 건물의 모든 집에는 사람이 산다.

easy: Still happening right now.

ex.en: Our class has an ongoing project about frogs.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 개구리에 대한 프로젝트를 계속 진행 중이다.

easy: A person who runs a machine.

ex.en: The crane operator lifted the heavy beam.
ex.ko: 크레인 기사가 무거운 철근을 들어 올렸다.

easy: A person who runs a business.

ex.en: The operator of the ice cream shop gave me a free cone.
ex.ko: 아이스크림 가게 주인이 나에게 콘을 공짜로 주었다.

easy: Hurting your body or your feelings.

ex.en: My knee is painful after I fell.
ex.ko: 넘어진 뒤로 무릎이 아프다.

easy: Getting everything ready before something happens.

ex.en: We made preparations for the class party.
ex.ko: 우리는 학급 파티를 준비했다.

easy: A hit with your fist.

ex.en: The boxer threw a quick punch.
ex.ko: 권투 선수가 재빠른 펀치를 날렸다.

easy: A tool that makes holes in things.

ex.en: I used a punch to make holes in the paper.
ex.ko: 나는 종이에 구멍을 뚫으려고 펀치를 썼다.

easy: Having a color between red and blue.

ex.en: Grandma knitted me a purple scarf.
ex.ko: 할머니가 나에게 보라색 목도리를 떠 주셨다.

easy: Signing up for something, like a class.

ex.en: Registration for the swim class starts Monday.
ex.ko: 수영 수업 등록은 월요일에 시작된다.

easy: A paper that shows you signed up or registered.

ex.en: Dad keeps the car registration in the glove box.
ex.ko: 아빠는 자동차 등록증을 수납함에 넣어 두신다.

easy: A story about people who fall in love.

ex.en: My big sister likes to read a romance on the bus.
ex.ko: 우리 누나는 버스에서 연애 소설 읽는 것을 좋아한다.

easy: As much as you need.

ex.en: We have sufficient food for the picnic.
ex.ko: 우리는 소풍에 쓸 음식이 충분하다.

easy: A short video that shows parts of a new movie.

ex.en: We watched the trailer for the new dragon movie.
ex.ko: 우리는 새 용 영화의 예고편을 봤다.

easy: A big cart pulled by a truck to carry things.

ex.en: Dad's truck pulled a trailer full of hay.
ex.ko: 아빠의 트럭이 건초를 가득 실은 트레일러를 끌었다.

easy: Below the ground.

ex.en: The subway runs through an underground tunnel.
ex.ko: 지하철은 지하 터널을 지나간다.

easy: Hurt in your body, like from an accident.

ex.en: The wounded bird could not fly.
ex.ko: 다친 새는 날 수 없었다.

easy: Important news that is said to the public in a serious way.

ex.en: The mayor made an announcement on TV.
ex.ko: 시장이 텔레비전에서 발표를 했다.

easy: Words said or written to tell everyone some news.

ex.en: The principal made an announcement about the snow day.
ex.ko: 교장 선생님이 눈 때문에 쉬는 날이라고 공지하셨다.

easy: Having to do with living things and the study of life.

ex.en: Our class did a biological experiment with seeds.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 씨앗으로 생물학 실험을 했다.

easy: Related to you by blood, like your birth parents.

ex.en: He is the biological son of my uncle.
ex.ko: 그는 삼촌의 친아들이다.

easy: A hurt spot on the skin made by teeth.

ex.en: The dog bite on my arm healed fast.
ex.ko: 팔에 난 개 물린 상처는 빨리 나았다.

easy: A small piece of food.

ex.en: Can I have a bite of your sandwich?
ex.ko: 네 샌드위치 한 입만 먹어도 돼?

easy: A sore spot on the skin from a bug.

ex.en: I scratched the mosquito bite on my leg.
ex.ko: 나는 다리의 모기 물린 자국을 긁었다.

easy: Closed so cars cannot go through.

ex.en: The street was blocked because of a parade.
ex.ko: 퍼레이드 때문에 길이 막혀 있었다.

easy: Stopped up so nothing can pass through.

ex.en: Our sink is blocked, so the water will not go down.
ex.ko: 싱크대가 막혀서 물이 내려가지 않는다.

easy: Damaged by a fire.

ex.en: We saw a burned house after the fire.
ex.ko: 우리는 불이 난 뒤 불에 탄 집을 봤다.

easy: Cooked too long, so it turned black.

ex.en: Dad's burned toast smelled smoky.
ex.ko: 아빠가 태운 토스트에서 연기 냄새가 났다.

easy: To be brave enough to try something scary.

ex.en: I do not dare to jump from the high rock.
ex.ko: 나는 높은 바위에서 뛰어내릴 엄두가 나지 않는다.

easy: To ask someone to do something scary to show they are brave.

ex.en: I dare you to touch the frog!
ex.ko: 개구리를 만져 볼 용기 있으면 해 봐!

easy: A big collection of information kept in a computer.

ex.en: The library keeps all its books in a computer database.
ex.ko: 도서관은 모든 책을 컴퓨터 데이터베이스에 보관한다.

easy: A mess where things are not where they belong.

ex.en: My room was in total disorder.
ex.ko: 내 방은 완전히 엉망이었다.

easy: A movie or TV show that tells true facts.

ex.en: We watched a documentary about penguins.
ex.ko: 우리는 펭귄에 관한 다큐멘터리를 봤다.

easy: Full of energy and action.

ex.en: Our new coach is a dynamic person.
ex.ko: 우리 새 코치님은 활기 넘치는 분이다.

easy: Fixed and made better by checking carefully.

ex.en: I read the edited version of my story.
ex.ko: 나는 편집된 내 이야기를 읽었다.

easy: A promise between two people to get married.

ex.en: My aunt's engagement party was fun.
ex.ko: 이모의 약혼 파티는 즐거웠다.

easy: To look for facts and learn about something.

ex.en: We explored the history of dinosaurs for our report.
ex.ko: 우리는 보고서를 쓰려고 공룡의 역사를 조사했다.

easy: To go to a new place to learn what is there.

ex.en: We explored the cave with flashlights.
ex.ko: 우리는 손전등을 들고 동굴을 탐험했다.

easy: To study something carefully to learn all about it.

ex.en: In science class we explore how plants grow.
ex.ko: 과학 시간에 우리는 식물이 어떻게 자라는지 탐구한다.

easy: A kind feeling that you like someone.

ex.en: The new girl quickly won the teacher's favor.
ex.ko: 새로 온 여자아이는 금방 선생님의 호감을 얻었다.

easy: A smaller number of things.

ex.en: Fewer kids came to school on the snowy day.
ex.ko: 눈 오는 날에는 학교에 온 아이들이 더 적었다.

easy: Video or film that was recorded.

ex.en: We watched footage of whales in the ocean.
ex.ko: 우리는 바다의 고래 영상을 봤다.

easy: Very serious and important.

ex.en: Forgetting to lock the door is a grave mistake.
ex.ko: 문을 잠그지 않는 것은 중대한 실수다.

easy: Carrying out a plan and making it happen.

ex.en: The class started the implementation of its recycling plan.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 재활용 계획을 실행에 옮기기 시작했다.

easy: A kind of lively music that first came from New Orleans.

ex.en: My dad plays jazz on the saxophone.
ex.ko: 아빠는 색소폰으로 재즈를 연주하신다.

easy: Having to do with books and writing.

ex.en: Our school has a literary club for young writers.
ex.ko: 우리 학교에는 어린 작가들을 위한 문학 동아리가 있다.

easy: To hide your real feelings.

ex.en: She masked her fear with a smile.
ex.ko: 그 애는 웃음으로 두려움을 감췄다.

easy: To cover a face with a mask.

ex.en: We masked our faces for the Halloween party.
ex.ko: 우리는 할로윈 파티를 위해 얼굴에 가면을 썼다.

easy: To hide something so it is hard to notice.

ex.en: Jam masks the taste of the medicine.
ex.ko: 잼이 약 맛을 가려 준다.

easy: Twelve o'clock at night.

ex.en: I tried to stay awake until midnight on New Year's Eve.
ex.ko: 나는 새해 전날 자정까지 깨어 있으려고 했다.

easy: A small furry animal with a long tail.

ex.en: A mouse ran across the kitchen floor.
ex.ko: 생쥐 한 마리가 부엌 바닥을 가로질러 달렸다.

easy: Filled up with too many people or things.

ex.en: The bus was packed with kids going to the zoo.
ex.ko: 버스는 동물원에 가는 아이들로 꽉 찼다.

easy: Pushed together tightly.

ex.en: We walked on the packed snow.
ex.ko: 우리는 단단히 다져진 눈 위를 걸었다.

easy: A big musical instrument with black and white keys that you press.

ex.en: I practice the piano every day after school.
ex.ko: 나는 방과 후 매일 피아노를 연습한다.

easy: To say good things about someone.

ex.en: Our teacher praised me for my neat writing.
ex.ko: 선생님은 내 깔끔한 글씨를 칭찬해 주셨다.

easy: Showing something to people so they can see it.

ex.en: The class gave a presentation on volcanoes.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 화산에 대해 발표를 했다.

easy: The study of how people think and feel.

ex.en: My mom studied psychology in college.
ex.ko: 엄마는 대학에서 심리학을 공부하셨다.
